content: दातृ {%a.%} (-त्री|{%f.%}) [दा-तृच्] .²1 Giving, offering, granting, presenting, bestowing, imparting, <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Liberal. --{%m.%} .({@-ता@}) .²11 A giver (in general); दाता मे भूभृतां नाथः <ls>Ku. 6. 1</ls>. .²2 A donor; एवं दातृगुरोर्गुणाः सुरतरोः सर्वेऽपि लोकोत्तराः <ls>Bv. 1. 66</ls>. .²3 A lender, creditor. .²4 A teacher. .²5 A cutter. .²6 A guardian; अदत्तमेवाददीत दातुर्वित्तं ममेति च <ls>Mb. 12. 132. 5</ls>. .²7 One who gives daughter or sister in marriage; <ls>Ms. 3. 172</ls>.
